zoe: Heads-up: customer hit a confusing flow where a key ended up as an org-level key because the project lookup RPC intermittently timed out. Repro below.
marc: ouch. paste the minimal request + log?
zoe: POST /keys { org: "org:delta", project: "proj:beta", sa: "sa:ingest" } but server shows project_lookup 504 then write with project_id=null. snippet:
```
[auth-proxy] GET /projects/proj:beta -> 504
[key-service] WRITE key { project_id: null, org_id: org:delta, created_by: console }
```
lina: product concern: customers assume per-project quotas apply. if it's org-level that's a billing surface. we should make the console explicitly call out when project context wasn't verified.
marc: engineering suggestion: return header `X-Key-Create-Note: fallback_org_timeout` when we created the key because of a timeout. Console treats any non-ok note as a confirmation path. Also emit telemetry event `key.create.note` with tags { note, proxy_status }.
zoe: UX: show an inline banner saying "Project couldn't be verified; key created at org level" with a Convert button. Convert should call an idempotent endpoint.
lina: agree. convert endpoint proposal: POST /keys/:id/convert { project_id } requires org-admin or key-owner, records audit event `key.convert`. no silent conversions.
marc: rollout plan: put header behind feature-flag `auth.key_note`. enable in canary at 0.5% traffic, telemetry sample 0.1% initially. dashboard: add chart "org-level-keys (created-by-timeout)" and correlate with auth-proxy 5xx rate. alert if ratio of org-level-by-timeout > 0.25% over 1h.
analytics-bot: telemetry: created metric `keys.org_fallback_rate` and dashboard tile seeded.
deploy-bot: scheduled: feature flag `auth.key_note` -> eng-platform-canary at 2024-05-04T14:00:00Z.
zoe: I'll write the convert API spec and mock the console confirmation. marc: I'll implement header and telemetry hook. lina: I'll prep docs and legal for audit wording. thanks! :thumbsup:
